title: Carry notifyOnNextDose into PendingDoseConfirmation when a too-soon warning is needed
description: PendingDoseConfirmation now requires a notifyOnNextDose field (task-005) -- this is the constructor call built when logDose reports NeedsConfirmation, so it must supply that new field from the value captured in the onSubmit lambda.
acceptance_criteria: The existing outcome.minutesRemaining, argument is unchanged
A new argument immediately follows it: notifyOnNextDose,
